versions.content: On reception of the UDS Service WriteDataByIdentifier (0x2E), the Dcm module shall check if the DID is supported (see configuration parameter DcmDspDid and DcmDspDidRange ) If not, the Dcm module shall send NRC 0x31 (Re- quest out of range) .
